# secopsctl cleanup

## cleanup smoke-artifacts

MUTATING (guarded): remove or neutralize secopsctl smoke artifacts

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text

```

```text
Find SIEM resources whose names start with secopsctl smoke-test prefixes,
then delete surfaces with a clean delete API, archive smoke rule exclusions,
and empty smoke reference lists. The command previews the plan first and
never targets names outside the secopsctl-owned smoke prefixes.
```
